```rust file=~/.ai/workflows/peer-review.rhai
resolve_prompt += "2. If INPUT looks like a GitHub issue (#NNN or github.com/.../issues/NNN), use gh issue view (detect repo from git remote) and use title+body as the spec. If the issue references a PRD path, read that too.\n";
resolve_prompt += "3. Otherwise treat INPUT as a free-form task description.\n";
resolve_prompt += "4. Also run: git branch --show-current, and note base branch preference: ";
resolve_prompt += base_branch;
resolve_prompt += "\n5. Return ONLY the resolved specification as plain markdown text (no code edits).\n";
resolve_prompt += "Include a top heading and enough detail for an implementer to plan.\n";

let resolved = agent(resolve_prompt, #{
    label: "resolve-spec",
    capability_mode: "read-only",
    agent_type: "general-purpose",
});

let spec_text = "";
if resolved != () && resolved.success && type_of(resolved.output) == "string" {
    spec_text = resolved.output;
} else if resolved != () && resolved.success {
    spec_text = json_encode(resolved.output);
} else {
    // Fall back to raw task so the loop can continue.
    if type_of(task) == "string" {
        spec_text = task;
    } else {
        spec_text = json_encode(task);
    }
    log("resolve agent failed or empty — using raw task text");
}

let spec_path = write_scratch_file("spec.md", spec_text);
log("Spec written to " + spec_path);

// ── Phase: Plan ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

phase("Plan");
log("Writing structured plan");

let plan_prompt = "";
plan_prompt += "You are the planning engineer for a peer-reviewed implementation. Do NOT implement yet.\n";
plan_prompt += "Explore the codebase with read_file / grep / list_dir as needed so the plan fits local patterns.\n\n";
plan_prompt += "## Spec\n";
plan_prompt += spec_text;
plan_prompt += "\n\n## Required plan fields\n";
plan_prompt += "- goal: one paragraph restating the task\n";
plan_prompt += "- approach: design/architecture choice and main tradeoff accepted\n";
plan_prompt += "- files: explicit list of paths to create or modify\n";
plan_prompt += "- consumer_map: for every new/moved field or abstraction, who must read/honor it (API schema, DB, list/read UI, exporters/transformers for EACH pipeline, importers, jobs). Mark intentional deferrals.\n";
plan_prompt += "- invariants: uniqueness/atomicity; whether DB constraint or transaction enforces it\n";
plan_prompt += "- authz: who can call new procedures; which existing gate (role/assignment/tenant helper) is reused\n";
plan_prompt += "- failure_modes: what hard-fails vs user-visible degradation; no silent ACTIVE/success on failed setup\n";
plan_prompt += "- out_of_scope: deliberate non-goals so reviewers don't churn\n";
plan_prompt += "- open_questions: uncertainties\n";
plan_prompt += "- implementation_steps: ordered concrete steps\n";
plan_prompt += "\nSelf-check while planning: soft success, write-only wiring, races, thin authZ, mount wipes, dual-path drift, envelope casts, tests that assert failure paths.\n";
plan_prompt += "Return the structured plan object only.\n";

let plan_result = agent(plan_prompt, #{
    label: "plan",
    capability_mode: "read-only",
    agent_type: "plan",
    output_schema: plan_schema,
});

if plan_result == () || !plan_result.success || plan_result.output == () {
    complete(#{
        ok: false,
        error: "Plan agent failed — cannot continue peer-review loop",
        spec_path: spec_path,
    });
}

let plan = plan_result.output;
let plan_files = as_array(plan.files);
let plan_steps = as_array(plan.implementation_steps);
let plan_json = json_encode(plan);
let plan_md = "";
plan_md += "# Plan\n\n## Goal\n";
plan_md += as_string(plan.goal);
plan_md += "\n\n## Approach\n";
plan_md += as_string(plan.approach);
plan_md += "\n\n## Files\n";
for f in plan_files {
    plan_md += "- ";
    plan_md += as_string(f);
    plan_md += "\n";
}
plan_md += "\n## Consumer map\n";
plan_md += as_string(plan.consumer_map);
plan_md += "\n\n## Invariants\n";
plan_md += as_string(plan.invariants);
plan_md += "\n\n## AuthZ\n";
plan_md += as_string(plan.authz);
plan_md += "\n\n## Failure modes\n";
plan_md += as_string(plan.failure_modes);
plan_md += "\n\n## Out of scope\n";
plan_md += as_string(plan.out_of_scope);
plan_md += "\n\n## Open questions\n";
plan_md += as_string(plan.open_questions);
plan_md += "\n\n## Steps\n";
for s in plan_steps {
    plan_md += "- ";
    plan_md += as_string(s);
    plan_md += "\n";
}
let plan_path = write_scratch_file("plan.md", plan_md);
log("Plan written to " + plan_path);

// ── Phase: Implement ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

phase("Implement");
log("Implementing against the plan");

let impl_prompt = "";
impl_prompt += "You are the implementing engineer. Execute the plan fully. Prefer existing helpers, auth gates, and DB patterns in this repo.\n";
impl_prompt += "Use the monorepo conventions (Nx via yarn nx, Prisma when needed). Do not expand out_of_scope.\n\n";
impl_prompt += "While implementing, self-check: soft success, write-only wiring, races, thin authZ, mount wipes, dual-path drift, envelope casts, failure-path tests.\n";
impl_prompt += "When soft-fails appear: harden exact types at the boundary; never paper with any / as any / more optionals.\n";
impl_prompt += "Verify build/typecheck for touched projects before finishing (e.g. yarn nx run <project>:typecheck or equivalent).\n\n";
impl_prompt += "## Spec\n";
impl_prompt += spec_text;
impl_prompt += "\n\n## Plan (JSON)\n";
impl_prompt += plan_json;
impl_prompt += "\n\nReturn: summary, files_touched (every created/modified path), build_ok, notes.\n";
impl_prompt += "files_touched must be accurate — reviewers only examine this list.\n";

let impl_result = agent(impl_prompt, #{
    label: "implement",
    capability_mode: "all",
    agent_type: "general-purpose",
    output_schema: implement_schema,
});

if impl_result == () || !impl_result.success || impl_result.output == () {
    complete(#{
        ok: false,
        error: "Implement agent failed",
        spec_path: spec_path,
        plan_path: plan_path,
    });
}

let impl = impl_result.output;
let files_touched = as_array(impl.files_touched);
if files_touched.len() == 0 {
    files_touched = plan_files;
}

// Prefer plan files unioned with reported touches.
files_touched = merge_files(plan_files, files_touched);

let files_md = "";
for f in files_touched {
    files_md += f;
    files_md += "\n";
}
let files_path = write_scratch_file("files-touched.md", files_md);
log("Implementation done; files_touched=" + files_touched.len().to_string() + " build_ok=" + impl.build_ok.to_string());

// Round tracking for summary
let all_round_stats = [];
let all_deferred = [];
let all_rejected = [];
let all_accepted_applied = [];
let strongest_arch = "fine";
let strongest_arch_note = "";
let files_block = files_prompt_block(files_touched);

// ── Review / Verify / Triage / Fix loop ────────────────────────────────────

let round_n = 1;
while round_n <= max_rounds {
    let round_label = "R" + round_n.to_string();
    let is_delta = round_n > 1;
    let focus_note = "";
    if is_delta {
        focus_note = "This is a DELTA re-review after fixes. Focus on the listed files and regressions introduced by recent fixes. Do not re-litigate already-correct code. Do not pad.";
    }

    // ── Review ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    phase("Review");
    log(round_label + ": spawning parallel specialists");

    let specialties = ["correctness", "security", "silent", "recurring", "testing", "deadcode", "duplication"];
    let specialty_labels = ["Correctness", "Security", "SilentFailure", "RecurringPattern", "Testing", "DeadCode", "Duplication"];
    let specialty_count = specialties.len();
    let review_jobs = [];
    let si = 0;
    for sp in specialties {
        let pr = make_review_prompt(sp, plan_json, files_block, round_label, focus_note);
        let agent_type = "general-purpose";
        if sp == "security" { agent_type = "backend-architect"; }
        if sp == "testing" { agent_type = "test-writer-fixer"; }
        review_jobs.push(#{
            prompt: pr,
            label: round_label + "-" + sp,
            capability_mode: "read-only",
            agent_type: agent_type,
            output_schema: findings_schema,
        });
        si += 1;
    }

    // Architecture only on first full pass (saves 1 agent per extra round).
    let arch_included = !is_delta;
    if arch_included {
        review_jobs.push(#{
            prompt: make_arch_prompt(plan_json, files_block),
            label: round_label + "-architecture",
            capability_mode: "read-only",
            agent_type: "plan",
            output_schema: arch_schema,
        });
    }

    let review_results = parallel(review_jobs);

    // Collect findings from actionable specialists; arch is last if present.
    let merged = [];
    let clean_specialists = [];
    let failed_specialists = [];
    let ri = 0;
    while ri < specialty_count {
        let r = review_results[ri];
        let label = specialty_labels[ri];
        let found = [];
        let ok = false;
        if r != () && r.success && r.output != () {
            found = as_array(r.output.findings);
            ok = true;
        }
        if !ok {
            failed_specialists.push(label);
            log(round_label + ": retrying specialist " + label);
            let retry = agent(
                make_review_prompt(specialties[ri], plan_json, files_block, round_label, focus_note),
                #{
                    label: round_label + "-" + specialties[ri] + "-retry",
                    capability_mode: "read-only",
                    agent_type: "general-purpose",
                    output_schema: findings_schema,
                }
            );
            if retry != () && retry.success && retry.output != () {
                found = as_array(retry.output.findings);
                ok = true;
            }
        }
        if !ok {
            merged.push(#{
                title: "reviewer-failed (" + label + ")",
                severity: "major",
                file: "general",
                line: "",
                observation: "Specialist " + label + " failed twice and produced no usable output.",
                why: "Coverage gap for this specialty in " + round_label,
                suggested_change: "Re-run peer-review for this specialty or manual review.",
                specialty: label,
            });
        } else if found.len() == 0 {
            clean_specialists.push(label);
        } else {
            for f in found {
                merged.push(#{
                    title: as_string(f.title),
                    severity: as_string(f.severity),
                    file: as_string(f.file),
                    line: as_string(f.line),
                    observation: as_string(f.observation),
                    why: as_string(f.why),
                    suggested_change: as_string(f.suggested_change),
                    specialty: label,
                });
            }
        }
        ri += 1;
    }

    // Architecture note
    if arch_included {
        let ar = review_results[specialty_count];
        let arch_verdict = "fine";
        let arch_note = "";
        if ar != () && ar.success && ar.output != () {
            if ar.output.verdict != () { arch_verdict = trimmed(ar.output.verdict); }
            if ar.output.note != () { arch_note = ar.output.note; }
        } else {
            // retry once
            let ar2 = agent(make_arch_prompt(plan_json, files_block), #{
                label: round_label + "-architecture-retry",
                capability_mode: "read-only",
                agent_type: "plan",
                output_schema: arch_schema,
            });
            if ar2 != () && ar2.success && ar2.output != () {
                if ar2.output.verdict != () { arch_verdict = trimmed(ar2.output.verdict); }
                if ar2.output.note != () { arch_note = ar2.output.note; }
            } else {
                arch_verdict = "fine";
                arch_note = "";
            }
        }
        // Rank: poor-fit > clear-better-path > fine
        if arch_verdict == "poor-fit" {
            strongest_arch = "poor-fit";
            strongest_arch_note = arch_note;
        } else if arch_verdict == "clear-better-path" && strongest_arch != "poor-fit" {
            strongest_arch = "clear-better-path";
            strongest_arch_note = arch_note;
        }
        let arch_md = "# Architecture sense-check (" + round_label + ")\n\nVerdict: " + arch_verdict + "\n\n" + arch_note + "\n";
        write_scratch_file("round-" + round_n.to_string() + "-architecture-note.md", arch_md);
        log(round_label + " architecture: " + arch_verdict);
    }

    // Dedup near-identical titles+files (keep higher severity)
    let deduped = [];
    for f in merged {
        let dup_idx = -1;
        let di = 0;
        for d in deduped {
            let same_file = d.file == f.file;
            let same_title = d.title == f.title;
            // crude near-dup: same file and overlapping title prefix
            if same_file && same_title {
                dup_idx = di;
            }
            di += 1;
        }
        if dup_idx < 0 {
            deduped.push(f);
        } else {
            if severity_rank(f.severity) > severity_rank(deduped[dup_idx].severity) {
                // replace with stronger severity; note both specialties
                let kept = deduped[dup_idx];
                let specs = kept.specialty + "+" + f.specialty;
                deduped[dup_idx] = #{
                    title: f.title,
                    severity: f.severity,
                    file: f.file,
                    line: f.line,
                    observation: f.observation,
                    why: f.why,
                    suggested_change: f.suggested_change,
                    specialty: specs,
                };
            }
        }
    }

    let comments_md = "# Review " + round_label + "\n\n## Summary\n";
    comments_md += "Merged ";
    comments_md += deduped.len().to_string();
    comments_md += " findings after specialist fan-out (pre-verification).\n\n## Comments\n";
    let ci = 0;
    for f in deduped {
        comments_md += "\n### C";
        comments_md += (ci + 1).to_string();
        comments_md += " — ";
        comments_md += f.title;
        comments_md += "\n- **Specialty**: ";
        comments_md += f.specialty;
        comments_md += "\n- **Severity**: ";
        comments_md += f.severity;
        comments_md += "\n- **File**: ";
        comments_md += f.file;
        comments_md += "\n- **Observation**: ";
        comments_md += f.observation;
        comments_md += "\n- **Why it matters**: ";
        comments_md += f.why;
        comments_md += "\n- **Suggested change**: ";
        comments_md += f.suggested_change;
        comments_md += "\n";
        ci += 1;
    }
    comments_md += "\n## Clean specialists\n";
    for c in clean_specialists {
        comments_md += "- ";
        comments_md += c;
        comments_md += ": no findings\n";
    }
    write_scratch_file("round-" + round_n.to_string() + "-comments.md", comments_md);
    log(round_label + ": " + deduped.len().to_string() + " findings pre-verify");

    if deduped.len() == 0 {
        all_round_stats.push(#{
            round: round_n,
            raised: 0,
            confirmed: 0,
            accepted: 0,
            rejected: 0,
            deferred: 0,
        });
        log(round_label + ": no findings — early exit remaining rounds");
        break;
    }

    // ── Verify (fail-closed) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    phase("Verify");
    // Cap what we verify to control budget; prioritize by severity.
    // Simple selection: take first MAX_VERIFY after sorting by severity rank desc.
    let ordered = [];
    // 4 buckets
    for f in deduped {
        if severity_rank(f.severity) == 4 { ordered.push(f); }
    }
    for f in deduped {
        if severity_rank(f.severity) == 3 { ordered.push(f); }
    }
    for f in deduped {
        if severity_rank(f.severity) == 2 { ordered.push(f); }
    }
    for f in deduped {
        if severity_rank(f.severity) == 1 { ordered.push(f); }
    }

    let to_verify = [];
    let vi = 0;
    for f in ordered {
        if vi < MAX_VERIFY {
            to_verify.push(f);
        }
        vi += 1;
    }
    if ordered.len() > MAX_VERIFY {
        log(round_label + ": verifying top " + MAX_VERIFY.to_string() + " of " + ordered.len().to_string() + " by severity; remainder dropped as unverified");
    }

    let vjobs = [];
    for f in to_verify {
        vjobs.push(#{
            prompt: make_verify_prompt(f),
            label: round_label + "-verify-" + f.file,
            capability_mode: "read-only",
            output_schema: verdict_schema,
        });
    }
    let verdicts = parallel(vjobs);

    let confirmed = [];
    let dropped = 0;
    let vj = 0;
    for v in verdicts {
        // Fail closed: missing/failed/unusable => not confirmed
        if v != () && v.success && v.output != () && v.output.real == true
            && v.output.evidence != () && trimmed(v.output.evidence) != "" {
            let base = to_verify[vj];
            confirmed.push(#{
                title: base.title,
                severity: base.severity,
                file: base.file,
                line: base.line,
                observation: base.observation,
                why: base.why,
                suggested_change: base.suggested_change,
                specialty: base.specialty,
                evidence: v.output.evidence,
                verify_reason: v.output.reason,
            });
        } else {
            dropped += 1;
        }
        vj += 1;
    }
    log(round_label + ": " + confirmed.len().to_string() + "/" + to_verify.len().to_string() + " findings survived verification (" + dropped.to_string() + " dropped)");

    let confirmed_md = "# Confirmed findings " + round_label + "\n\n";
    confirmed_md += findings_prompt_block(confirmed);
    write_scratch_file("round-" + round_n.to_string() + "-confirmed.md", confirmed_md);

    if confirmed.len() == 0 {
        all_round_stats.push(#{
            round: round_n,
            raised: deduped.len(),
            confirmed: 0,
            accepted: 0,
            rejected: 0,
            deferred: 0,
        });
        log(round_label + ": nothing confirmed — early exit remaining rounds");
        break;
    }

    // ── Triage (independent judge — NOT the implementer) ──────────────────
    phase("Triage");
    log(round_label + ": independent judge triaging confirmed findings");

    let triage_prompt = "";
    triage_prompt += "You are an independent triage judge. You did NOT implement this code and must not defend it.\n";
    triage_prompt += "Only CONFIRMED findings (already adversarially verified against the code) are listed.\n";
    triage_prompt += "For each finding, decide accept | reject | defer.\n\n";
    triage_prompt += "Rules:\n";
    triage_prompt += "- accept: correct, in scope, and should be implemented now. Include implementation_note with the specific edit.\n";
    triage_prompt += "- reject: wrong, already handled, misread of intentional plan tradeoff, or fix would be harmful. Reasoning mandatory.\n";
    triage_prompt += "- defer: reasonable but out of scope / follow-up. Reasoning + where to track mandatory.\n";
    triage_prompt += "- Severity is informational, not binding. A cheap nit can be accept; a misunderstood blocker can be reject.\n";
    triage_prompt += "- Prefer accept for real blocker/major security, soft-success, write-only wiring, auth fail-open, data-loss soft-fails.\n";
    triage_prompt += "- Soft-fail fixes must harden exact types at boundaries — never accept a fix that adds any/as any/more optionals.\n";
    triage_prompt += "- Read the plan's out_of_scope and the code before deciding. Use tools.\n";
    triage_prompt += "- index is the INDEX number shown on each finding (0-based).\n";
    triage_prompt += "- Every finding must appear exactly once in decisions.\n\n";
    triage_prompt += "## Plan (JSON)\n";
    triage_prompt += plan_json;
    triage_prompt += "\n\n## Confirmed findings\n";
    triage_prompt += findings_prompt_block(confirmed);
    triage_prompt += "\nReturn decisions array covering every index.\n";

    let triage_result = agent(triage_prompt, #{
        label: round_label + "-triage",
        capability_mode: "read-only",
        agent_type: "general-purpose",
        output_schema: triage_schema,
    });

    let decisions = [];
    if triage_result != () && triage_result.success && triage_result.output != () {
        decisions = as_array(triage_result.output.decisions);
    }
    if decisions.len() == 0 {
        // Fail closed for triage failure: defer all confirmed (do not auto-accept)
        log(round_label + ": triage agent failed — deferring all confirmed findings");
        let ti = 0;
        for f in confirmed {
            decisions.push(#{
                index: ti,
                decision: "defer",
                reasoning: "Triage agent failed; deferred automatically for human review.",
                implementation_note: "",
            });
            ti += 1;
        }
    }

    let accepted = [];
    let n_accept = 0;
    let n_reject = 0;
    let n_defer = 0;
    let decisions_md = "# Round " + round_n.to_string() + " decisions (confirmed findings only)\n\n";

    for d in decisions {
        let idx = d.index;
        if type_of(idx) == "f64" { idx = idx; }
        // bounds check
        if idx < 0 || idx >= confirmed.len() {
            continue;
        }
        let f = confirmed[idx];
        let dec = trimmed(d.decision);
        let reasoning = if d.reasoning != () { d.reasoning } else { "" };
        let impl_note = if d.implementation_note != () { d.implementation_note } else { "" };

        decisions_md += "## INDEX ";
        decisions_md += idx.to_string();
        decisions_md += " — ";
        decisions_md += f.title;
        decisions_md += "\n- **Decision**: ";
        decisions_md += dec;
        decisions_md += "\n- **Reasoning**: ";
        decisions_md += reasoning;
        if impl_note != "" {
            decisions_md += "\n- **Implementation note**: ";
            decisions_md += impl_note;
        }
        decisions_md += "\n\n";

        if dec == "accept" {
            n_accept += 1;
            accepted.push(#{
                title: f.title,
                severity: f.severity,
                file: f.file,
                line: f.line,
                observation: f.observation,
                why: f.why,
                suggested_change: f.suggested_change,
                specialty: f.specialty,
                evidence: f.evidence,
                implementation_note: impl_note,
            });
        } else if dec == "reject" {
            n_reject += 1;
            all_rejected.push(#{
                round: round_n,
                title: f.title,
                reason: reasoning,
            });
        } else {
            n_defer += 1;
            all_deferred.push(#{
                round: round_n,
                title: f.title,
                file: f.file,
                reason: reasoning,
                specialty: f.specialty,
            });
        }
    }

    write_scratch_file("round-" + round_n.to_string() + "-decisions.md", decisions_md);
    log(round_label + " triage: accept=" + n_accept.to_string() + " reject=" + n_reject.to_string() + " defer=" + n_defer.to_string());

    all_round_stats.push(#{
        round: round_n,
        raised: deduped.len(),
        confirmed: confirmed.len(),
        accepted: n_accept,
        rejected: n_reject,
        deferred: n_defer,
    });

    if accepted.len() == 0 {
        log(round_label + ": nothing accepted — skipping fix and further rounds");
        break;
    }

    // ── Fix ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    phase("Fix");
    log(round_label + ": applying " + accepted.len().to_string() + " accepted findings");

    let fix_prompt = "";
    fix_prompt += "You are the implementing engineer applying ACCEPTED review fixes only.\n";
    fix_prompt += "Do not re-architect. Do not expand scope. Implement each accepted item's suggested_change / implementation_note.\n\n";
    fix_prompt += "Soft-fail / soft-type fixes:\n";
    fix_prompt += "1. Determine the exact expected type (domain, API, DB, callers).\n";
    fix_prompt += "2. Tighten that hard type; validate once at the boundary.\n";
    fix_prompt += "3. Remove the silent fallback / empty default / type-papering.\n";
    fix_prompt += "4. NEVER fix with any, as any, as unknown as T, blanket !, or by making more fields optional.\n";
    fix_prompt += "If applying a fix breaks the build/types, put it in rejected_during_apply with reason — do not silently drop.\n";
    fix_prompt += "Verify build/typecheck for touched projects.\n\n";
    fix_prompt += "## Plan (JSON)\n";
    fix_prompt += plan_json;
    fix_prompt += "\n\n## Accepted findings to apply\n";
    fix_prompt += json_encode(accepted);
    fix_prompt += "\n\nReturn summary, files_touched, build_ok, applied (titles), rejected_during_apply.\n";

    let fix_result = agent(fix_prompt, #{
        label: round_label + "-fix",
        capability_mode: "all",
        agent_type: "general-purpose",
        output_schema: fix_schema,
    });

    if fix_result != () && fix_result.success && fix_result.output != () {
        let fx = fix_result.output;
        let fx_files = as_array(fx.files_touched);
        if fx_files.len() > 0 {
            files_touched = merge_files(files_touched, fx_files);
            files_block = files_prompt_block(files_touched);
            let fm = "";
            for f in files_touched {
                fm += as_string(f);
                fm += "\n";
            }
            write_scratch_file("files-touched.md", fm);
        }
        for t in as_array(fx.applied) {
            all_accepted_applied.push(#{ round: round_n, title: as_string(t) });
        }
        for r in as_array(fx.rejected_during_apply) {
            all_rejected.push(#{
                round: round_n,
                title: as_string(r.title),
                reason: "rejected during apply: " + as_string(r.reason),
            });
        }
        let build_ok_str = "unknown";
        if fx.build_ok != () { build_ok_str = fx.build_ok.to_string(); }
        log(round_label + " fix done build_ok=" + build_ok_str);
    } else {
        log(round_label + ": fix agent failed — stopping further rounds");
        break;
    }

    round_n += 1;
}

// ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

phase("Summary");
log("Writing final summary");

let summary_md = "";
summary_md += "# Peer review summary\n\n";
summary_md += "**Spec source**: see scratch/spec.md\n";
summary_md += "**Review model**: plan → implement → parallel specialists → adversarial verify (fail-closed) → independent triage → fix";
if max_rounds > 1 {
    summary_md += " → optional delta re-review";
}
summary_md += "\n";
summary_md += "**Max rounds**: ";
summary_md += max_rounds.to_string();
summary_md += "\n**Files touched**: ";
summary_md += files_touched.len().to_string();
summary_md += "\n\n## What was built\n\n";
summary_md += as_string(impl.summary);
summary_md += "\n\n## Review rounds\n";

for st in all_round_stats {
    summary_md += "\n### Round ";
    summary_md += st.round.to_string();
    summary_md += "\n- Raised (pre-verify): ";
    summary_md += st.raised.to_string();
    summary_md += "\n- Confirmed (post-verify): ";
    summary_md += st.confirmed.to_string();
    summary_md += "\n- Accepted: ";
    summary_md += st.accepted.to_string();
    summary_md += " | Rejected: ";
    summary_md += st.rejected.to_string();
    summary_md += " | Deferred: ";
    summary_md += st.deferred.to_string();
    summary_md += "\n";
}

summary_md += "\n## Applied fixes\n";
if all_accepted_applied.len() == 0 {
    summary_md += "\n(none)\n";
} else {
    for a in all_accepted_applied {
        summary_md += "- R";
        summary_md += a.round.to_string();
        summary_md += ": ";
        summary_md += a.title;
        summary_md += "\n";
    }
}

summary_md += "\n## Deferred items\n";
if all_deferred.len() == 0 {
    summary_md += "\n(none)\n";
} else {
    for d in all_deferred {
        summary_md += "- R";
        summary_md += d.round.to_string();
        summary_md += " [";
        summary_md += d.specialty;
        summary_md += "] ";
        summary_md += d.title;
        summary_md += " (";
        summary_md += d.file;
        summary_md += "): ";
        summary_md += d.reason;
        summary_md += "\n";
    }
}

summary_md += "\n## Rejected items\n";
if all_rejected.len() == 0 {
    summary_md += "\n(none)\n";
} else {
    for r in all_rejected {
        summary_md += "- R";
        summary_md += r.round.to_string();
        summary_md += ": ";
        summary_md += r.title;
        summary_md += " — ";
        summary_md += r.reason;
        summary_md += "\n";
    }
}

if strongest_arch != "fine" {
    summary_md += "\n## Architecture sense-check (user advisory)\n\n";
    summary_md += "**Verdict**: ";
    summary_md += strongest_arch;
    summary_md += "\n\nFor your consideration — the architecture sense-check thought:\n\n";
    summary_md += strongest_arch_note;
    summary_md += "\n\nThis is not a rewrite demand and was never triaged as implementable work during the loop.\n";
}

summary_md += "\n## Artifacts\n";
summary_md += "- scratch/spec.md\n- scratch/plan.md\n- scratch/files-touched.md\n";
summary_md += "- scratch/round-*-comments.md / confirmed.md / decisions.md\n";
summary_md += "- scratch/round-1-architecture-note.md (if produced)\n";

let report_path = write_scratch_file("summary.md", summary_md);

// Optional: polish report via agent for readability (cheap single call)
let polish = agent(
    "Polish this peer-review summary for a human reader. Keep all facts, counts, deferred items, and architecture note. Return only markdown in report_markdown. Do not invent findings.\n\n" + summary_md,
    #{
        label: "summary-polish",
        capability_mode: "read-only",
        output_schema: summary_schema,
    }
);
if polish != () && polish.success && polish.output != () && polish.output.report_markdown != () {
    let polished = polish.output.report_markdown;
    if trimmed(polished) != "" {
        report_path = write_scratch_file("summary.md", polished);
        summary_md = polished;
    }
}

log("Peer-review complete → " + report_path);

complete(#{
    ok: true,
    path: report_path,
    report: summary_md,
    files_touched: files_touched,
    rounds: all_round_stats,
    deferred: all_deferred,
    architecture: #{
        verdict: strongest_arch,
        note: strongest_arch_note,
    },
    plan_path: plan_path,
    spec_path: spec_path,
});
```

#### `~/.ai/dsh-plugins/sql-explorer/README.md`

````markdown file=~/.ai/dsh-plugins/sql-explorer/README.md mode=600
# SQL Explorer for DeepSeek Harness

A per-Session PostgreSQL browser that lives as a conversation view tab, next
to **Chat** and **Trajectory**. Each Session opens the tab against the database
that Session's working directory uses — including the isolated `dbname_wtN`
database that `/monorepo-worktree` creates for a slot.

## How the database is found

1. The Host reads the Session's current working directory (the directory the
   Session was opened in, or the one changed with the working-directory tool).
2. It walks up from there looking for a `.worktree-slot` marker and a
   `DATABASE_URL` in `.env`, `.env.local`, `.env.development`, or
   `.env.development.local`.
3. The first `DATABASE_URL` wins. When it sits beside a `.worktree-slot`
   marker, the panel shows the slot number and warns if the marker's
   `DB_NAME` disagrees with the URL.
4. A manual `postgresql://` URL entered in the Connection panel overrides the
   detection for that Session until the Host restarts or the override is
   reset.

## Host routes

| Route | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /sql-explorer/target?sessionId=` | Resolve the Session's database. |
| `GET /sql-explorer/ping?sessionId=` | Verify the connection and read server facts. |
| `GET /sql-explorer/schema?sessionId=` | Schemas, tables, columns, row estimates. |
| `POST /sql-explorer/query` | Run one statement (`{ sessionId, sql, limit }`). |
| `POST /sql-explorer/connect` | Store a manual URL for the Session. |
| `DELETE /sql-explorer/connect?sessionId=` | Drop the manual URL. |

Every request must carry `x-dsh-sql-explorer: 1`, which keeps cross-origin
pages from driving the route. Credentials never reach the browser: the
connection string stays in the Host and the panel receives only the database
name, host, port, user, and detection source.

## Requirements

- The browser Web GUI. Electron loads the page from `file://`, so the panel's
  fetches cannot reach the Host.
- A `psql` client. The Host looks at `SQL_EXPLORER_PSQL`, then
  `/opt/homebrew/bin/psql`, `/usr/local/bin/psql`, `/usr/bin/psql`, and
  `/opt/local/bin/psql`.

## Behaviour notes

- One statement per run. `psql -c` reports the last result set of a
  multi-statement string.
- The row cap wraps row-returning statements in `SELECT * FROM (…) LIMIT n`.
  If the wrapped form fails, the statement is retried unwrapped and that error
  is reported.
- `NULL` cells are sent as a sentinel because the transport is CSV; a literal
  `<NULL>` text value is indistinguishable from a null.
- Query history and the editor draft are stored per Session in
  `localStorage`.

## Layout

```
sql-explorer/
  package.json      Bundle manifest: patch, client module, locale, icon
  cordis.patch.yml  Inserts the Host row
  index.js          Host half: detection + psql execution + HTTP routes
  client.js         Browser half: conversation view tab and the explorer UI
  locale/*.json     Plugin Manager display metadata
  icon.svg          Plugin artwork
```
````

```js file=~/.ai/dsh-plugins/sql-explorer/client.js mode=600
.sqx-kv dt { color: var(--dsw-alias-label-secondary); }
.sqx-kv dd { margin: 0; word-break: break-all; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; }
.sqx-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 5px 7px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary); background: var(--dsw-alias-bg-base); border: 1px solid var(--dsw-alias-border-l1); border-radius: 6px; }
.sqx-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--dsw-alias-brand-primary); }
.sqx-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sqx-banner { margin: 6px 10px 0; }
.sqx-note { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--dsw-alias-label-secondary); }
.sqx-note-bad { color: var(--dsw-alias-state-error-primary); }
.sqx-note-ok { color: var(--dsw-alias-state-success-primary); }
.sqx-chevron { display: inline-block; width: 9px; color: var(--dsw-alias-label-secondary); flex: none; transition: transform .12s ease; }
.sqx-chevron.sqx-open { transform: rotate(90deg); }
`;

    // ── Icons ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    function RefreshGlyph() {
      return h('svg', {
        width: 14, height: 14, viewBox: '0 0 24 24', fill: 'none',
        stroke: 'currentColor', strokeWidth: 2, strokeLinecap: 'round',
        strokeLinejoin: 'round', 'aria-hidden': true, focusable: false,
      },
        h('path', { d: 'M20 11a8 8 0 1 0-2.34 5.66' }),
        h('path', { d: 'M20 5v6h-6' }),
      );
    }

    function PlayGlyph() {
      return h('svg', {
        width: 11, height: 11, viewBox: '0 0 24 24', fill: 'currentColor',
        'aria-hidden': true, focusable: false,
      }, h('path', { d: 'M8 5v14l11-7z' }));
    }

    function GearGlyph() {
      return h('svg', {
        width: 14, height: 14, viewBox: '0 0 24 24', fill: 'none',
        stroke: 'currentColor', strokeWidth: 1.8, strokeLinecap: 'round',
        strokeLinejoin: 'round', 'aria-hidden': true, focusable: false,
      },
        h('circle', { cx: 12, cy: 12, r: 3 }),
        h('path', { d: 'M19.4 15a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 .34 1.88l.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83 2.83l-.06-.06a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.88-.34 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1 1.56V21a2 2 0 1 1-4 0v-.09a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.11-1.56 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.88.34l-.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83-2.83l.06-.06a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 .34-1.88 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.56-1H3a2 2 0 1 1 0-4h.09a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.56-1.11 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-.34-1.88l-.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83-2.83l.06.06a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.88.34H9a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1-1.56V3a2 2 0 1 1 4 0v.09a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1 1.56 1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.88-.34l.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83 2.83l-.06.06a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-.34 1.88V9a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.56 1H21a2 2 0 1 1 0 4h-.09a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.51 1z' }),
      );
    }

    function Chevron(props) {
      return h('span', { className: `sqx-chevron${props.open ? ' sqx-open' : ''}`, 'aria-hidden': true }, '▶');
    }

    // ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    function readJsonStorage(key, fallback) {
      try {
        const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
        if (raw === null) return fallback;
        return JSON.parse(raw);
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`[sql-explorer] could not read ${key}`, error);
        return fallback;
      }
    }

    function writeJsonStorage(key, value) {
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`[sql-explorer] could not write ${key}`, error);
      }
    }

    function useStoredState(key, initial) {
      const [value, setValue] = React.useState(() => readJsonStorage(key, initial));
      React.useEffect(() => { writeJsonStorage(key, value); }, [key, value]);
      return [value, setValue];
    }

    async function call(path, init) {
      const headers = { 'x-dsh-sql-explorer': '1' };
      if (init && init.body !== undefined) headers['content-type'] = 'application/json';
      const response = await fetch(API + path, { ...init, headers });
      const text = await response.text();
      let payload = {};
      if (text !== '') {
        try {
          payload = JSON.parse(text);
        } catch {
          throw Object.assign(new Error(`Unexpected response from the Host (${response.status}).`), { detail: {} });
        }
      }
      if (!response.ok) {
        const detail = payload && payload.error ? payload.error : {};
        throw Object.assign(new Error(detail.message || `Request failed (${response.status}).`), { detail });
      }
      return payload;
    }

    function formatDuration(ms) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(ms)) return '';
      if (ms < 1000) return `${ms} ms`;
      return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(2)} s`;
    }

    function formatCount(value) {
      if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
      if (value < 1000) return String(value);
      if (value < 1_000_000) return `${(value / 1000).toFixed(value < 10_000 ? 1 : 0)}k`;
      return `${(value / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
    }

    function quoteIdentifier(name) {
      return `"${String(name).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
    }

    function kindKey(kind) {
      switch (kind) {
        case 'v': return 'kind.view';
        case 'm': return 'kind.matview';
        case 'f': return 'kind.foreign';
        case 'p': return 'kind.partitioned';
        default: return 'kind.table';
      }
    }

    function toCsvText(columns, rows) {
      const escape = (value) => {
        if (value === null) return '';
        const text = String(value);
        return /[",\n\r]/.test(text) ? `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : text;
      };
      const lines = [columns.map(escape).join(',')];
      for (const row of rows) lines.push(row.map(escape).join(','));
      return lines.join('\n');
    }

    function downloadText(filename, text) {
      const blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const anchor = document.createElement('a');
      anchor.href = url;
      anchor.download = filename;
      anchor.rel = 'noopener';
      anchor.click();
      window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
    }

    // ── Result grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    function ResultGrid(props) {
      const t = props.t;
      const columns = props.columns;
      const rows = props.rows;
      const [showAll, setShowAll] = React.useState(false);
      React.useEffect(() => { setShowAll(false); }, [rows]);
      const visible = showAll ? rows : rows.slice(0, MAX_GRID_ROWS);

      return h('div', { className: 'sqx-gridwrap' },
        h('table', { className: 'sqx-grid' },
          h('thead', null,
            h('tr', null,
              h('th', { className: 'sqx-rownum' }, t('results.rowNumber')),
              columns.map((column, index) => h('th', { key: index, title: column }, column)),
            ),
          ),
          h('tbody', null,
            visible.map((row, rowIndex) => h('tr', { key: rowIndex },
              h('td', { className: 'sqx-rownum' }, rowIndex + 1),
              columns.map((column, columnIndex) => {
                const value = row[columnIndex];
                if (value === null || value === undefined) {
                  return h('td', { key: columnIndex, className: 'sqx-null' }, t('results.null'));
                }
                return h('td', { key: columnIndex, title: String(value) }, String(value));
              }),
            )),
          ),
        ),
        rows.length > MAX_GRID_ROWS && !showAll
          ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-empty' },
              t('results.truncated', { shown: MAX_GRID_ROWS, total: rows.length }),
              ' ',
              h('button', {
                type: 'button',
                className: 'sqx-btn sqx-btn-quiet',
                onClick: () => setShowAll(true),
              }, t('results.showAll')),
            )
          : null,
      );
    }

    // ── Explorer body ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    function Explorer(props) {
      const t = props.t || ((key) => key);
      const sessionId = props.sessionId;

      const [target, setTarget] = React.useState(null);
      const [targetError, setTargetError] = React.useState(null);
      const [resolving, setResolving] = React.useState(false);
      const [connection, setConnection] = React.useState(null);

      const [schema, setSchema] = React.useState(null);
      const [schemaError, setSchemaError] = React.useState(null);
      const [schemaLoading, setSchemaLoading] = React.useState(false);
      const [schemaOpen, setSchemaOpen] = React.useState(true);
      const [schemaFilter, setSchemaFilter] = React.useState('');
      const [expandedSchemas, setExpandedSchemas] = React.useState({});
      const [expandedTables, setExpandedTables] = React.useState({});

      const [draft, setDraft] = useStoredState(`dsh.sql-explorer.draft.v1.${sessionId}`, 'SELECT * FROM public.users LIMIT 50;');
      const [history, setHistory] = useStoredState(`dsh.sql-explorer.history.v1.${sessionId}`, []);
      const [prefs, setPrefs] = useStoredState(PREFS_KEY, { limit: 500 });

      const [running, setRunning] = React.useState(false);
      const [result, setResult] = React.useState(null);
      const [error, setError] = React.useState(null);

      const [historyOpen, setHistoryOpen] = React.useState(false);
      const [connectionOpen, setConnectionOpen] = React.useState(false);
      const [manualUrl, setManualUrl] = React.useState('');
      const [manualStatus, setManualStatus] = React.useState(null);
      const [manualBusy, setManualBusy] = React.useState(false);

      const limit = Number.isFinite(prefs.limit) ? prefs.limit : 500;

      const loadTarget = React.useCallback(async () => {
        setResolving(true);
        setTargetError(null);
        try {
          const payload = await call(`/target?sessionId=${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}`, { method: 'GET' });
          setTarget(payload.target);
          setConnection(null);
        } catch (failure) {
          setTarget(null);
          setConnection(null);
          setTargetError({ message: failure.message, detail: failure.detail || {} });
        } finally {
          setResolving(false);
        }
      }, [sessionId]);

      const loadSchema = React.useCallback(async () => {
        setSchemaLoading(true);
        setSchemaError(null);
        try {
          const payload = await call(`/schema?sessionId=${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}`, { method: 'GET' });
          setSchema(payload.schema);
          setTarget(payload.target);
          setExpandedSchemas((current) => {
            if (Object.keys(current).length > 0) return current;
            const first = payload.schema.schemas.find((entry) => entry.name === 'public') || payload.schema.schemas[0];
            return first ? { [first.name]: true } : {};
          });
        } catch (failure) {
          setSchema(null);
          setSchemaError({ message: failure.message, detail: failure.detail || {} });
        } finally {
          setSchemaLoading(false);
        }
      }, [sessionId]);

      const ping = React.useCallback(async () => {
        try {
          const payload = await call(`/ping?sessionId=${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}`, { method: 'GET' });
          setConnection({ ok: true, ...payload.connection });
        } catch (failure) {
          setConnection({ ok: false, message: failure.message, detail: failure.detail || {} });
        }
      }, [sessionId]);

      React.useEffect(() => {
        setTarget(null);
        setSchema(null);
        setResult(null);
        setError(null);
        setConnection(null);
        void loadTarget();
      }, [loadTarget]);

      React.useEffect(() => {
        if (target === null) return;
        void loadSchema();
        void ping();
      }, [target === null ? null : target.database, target === null ? null : target.override, loadSchema, ping]);

      const run = React.useCallback(async () => {
        const statement = draft.trim();
        if (statement === '' || running) return;
        setRunning(true);
        setError(null);
        setResult(null);
        try {
          const payload = await call('/query', {
            method: 'POST',
            body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId, sql: statement, limit }),
          });
          setResult(payload);
          setHistory((current) => [{
            sql: statement,
            at: new Date().toISOString(),
            ok: true,
            rows: payload.rowCount,
            ms: payload.durationMs,
          }, ...current].slice(0, 50));
        } catch (failure) {
          setError({ message: failure.message, detail: failure.detail || {} });
          setHistory((current) => [{
            sql: statement,
            at: new Date().toISOString(),
            ok: false,
            rows: 0,
            ms: 0,
          }, ...current].slice(0, 50));
        } finally {
          setRunning(false);
        }
      }, [draft, running, sessionId, limit, setHistory]);

      const onKeyDown = (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) {
          event.preventDefault();
          void run();
        }
      };

      const connectManual = async () => {
        const url = manualUrl.trim();
        if (!/^postgres(ql)?:\/\//i.test(url)) {
          setManualStatus({ ok: false, message: t('connection.invalid') });
          return;
        }
        setManualBusy(true);
        setManualStatus(null);
        try {
          await call('/connect', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId, url }) });
          setManualStatus({ ok: true, message: t('connection.saved') });
          setManualUrl('');
          await loadTarget();
        } catch (failure) {
          setManualStatus({ ok: false, message: `${t('connection.failed')} ${failure.message}` });
        } finally {
          setManualBusy(false);
        }
      };

      const resetManual = async () => {
        setManualBusy(true);
        setManualStatus(null);
        try {
          await call(`/connect?sessionId=${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
          setManualStatus(null);
          await loadTarget();
        } catch (failure) {
          setManualStatus({ ok: false, message: `${t('connection.failed')} ${failure.message}` });
        } finally {
          setManualBusy(false);
        }
      };

      const insertTable = (schemaName, tableName) => {
        setDraft(`SELECT *\nFROM ${quoteIdentifier(schemaName)}.${quoteIdentifier(tableName)}\nLIMIT 50;`);
      };

      const refresh = () => {
        void loadTarget();
        void loadSchema();
        void ping();
      };

      const filtered = React.useMemo(() => {
        if (schema === null) return [];
        const query = schemaFilter.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (query === '') return schema.schemas;
        return schema.schemas
          .map((entry) => ({
            ...entry,
            tables: entry.tables.filter((table) => (
              `${entry.name}.${table.name}`.toLowerCase().includes(query)
              || table.columns.some((column) => column.name.toLowerCase().includes(query))
            )),
          }))
          .filter((entry) => entry.tables.length > 0);
      }, [schema, schemaFilter]);

      const tableCount = schema === null
        ? 0
        : schema.schemas.reduce((total, entry) => total + entry.tables.length, 0);

      const dotClass = connection === null ? '' : (connection.ok ? 'sqx-ok' : 'sqx-bad');
      const statusText = resolving
        ? t('top.connecting')
        : target === null
          ? t('top.noTarget')
          : connection === null
            ? ''
            : connection.ok ? t('status.ok') : t('status.bad');

      const topBadge = target === null
        ? null
        : target.slot !== null && target.slot !== undefined
          ? h('span', { className: 'sqx-badge' }, t('top.source.slot', { slot: target.slot }))
          : target.override
            ? h('span', { className: 'sqx-badge' }, t('top.override'))
            : null;

      const body = target === null
        ? renderEmptyState()
        : h('div', { className: 'sqx-body' },
            renderSchema(),
            h('div', { className: 'sqx-main' }, renderEditor(), renderOutput()),
          );

      return h('div', { className: 'sqx-root' },
        h('div', { className: 'sqx-top' },
          h('span', { className: `sqx-dot ${dotClass}`, title: statusText }),
          h('span', { className: 'sqx-name', title: target === null ? t('title') : target.database }, target === null ? t('title') : target.database),
          topBadge,
          h('span', { className: 'sqx-spacer' }),
          h('button', {
            type: 'button', className: 'sqx-icon-btn', title: t('top.refresh'),
            'aria-label': t('top.refresh'), onClick: refresh,
          }, h(RefreshGlyph)),
          h('button', {
            type: 'button', className: 'sqx-icon-btn', title: t('top.connection'),
            'aria-label': t('top.connection'),
            onClick: () => setConnectionOpen((open) => !open),
          }, h(GearGlyph)),
        ),
        target === null ? null : h('div', { className: 'sqx-sub' },
          h('span', null, `${target.host}:${target.port}`),
          h('span', null, '·'),
          h('span', { title: statusText }, t(`top.source.${target.source.startsWith('worktree') ? 'slot' : target.override ? 'manual' : 'dotenv'}`, { slot: target.slot })),
        ),
        target !== null && connection !== null && !connection.ok
          ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-note sqx-note-bad sqx-banner' }, connection.message)
          : null,
        target !== null && target.warning !== undefined
          ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-note sqx-banner' }, target.warning)
          : null,
        connectionOpen ? renderConnectionPanel() : null,
        body,
      );

      // ── Render functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

      function renderEmptyState() {
        if (resolving) {
          return h('div', { className: 'sqx-empty' }, t('top.connecting'));
        }
        return h('div', { className: 'sqx-empty' },
          h('div', { className: 'sqx-error-title' }, t('empty.noTargetTitle')),
          targetError !== null ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-error-message' }, targetError.message) : null,
          h('div', { className: 'sqx-row' },
            h('button', { type: 'button', className: 'sqx-btn', onClick: refresh }, t('empty.retry')),
            h('button', {
              type: 'button', className: 'sqx-btn sqx-btn-quiet',
              onClick: () => setConnectionOpen(true),
            }, t('empty.manual')),
          ),
          h('div', { className: 'sqx-note' }, t('empty.hint')),
        );
      }

      function renderSchema() {
        const open = schemaOpen;
        return h('div', { className: 'sqx-section sqx-schema' },
          h('div', { className: 'sqx-section-head' },
            h('button', {
              type: 'button', className: 'sqx-icon-btn', title: open ? t('schema.collapse') : t('schema.expand'),
              'aria-expanded': open,
              onClick: () => setSchemaOpen((value) => !value),
            }, h(Chevron, { open })),
            h('span', { className: 'sqx-section-title' }, t('schema.title')),
            h('span', { className: 'sqx-count' }, String(tableCount)),
            h('span', { className: 'sqx-spacer' }),
            h('button', {
              type: 'button', className: 'sqx-icon-btn', title: t('schema.reload'),
              'aria-label': t('schema.reload'), onClick: () => { void loadSchema(); },
            }, h(RefreshGlyph)),
          ),
          open ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-schema-body' },
            h('input', {
              className: 'sqx-search', type: 'search', value: schemaFilter,
              placeholder: t('schema.search'), 'aria-label': t('schema.search'),
              onChange: (event) => setSchemaFilter(event.target.value),
            }),
            schemaLoading
              ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-note' }, t('schema.loading'))
              : schemaError !== null
                ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-note sqx-note-bad' }, schemaError.message)
                : filtered.length === 0
                  ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-note' }, t('schema.empty'))
                  : filtered.map((entry) => {
                      const schemaExpanded = expandedSchemas[entry.name] === true;
                      return h('div', { className: 'sqx-schema-group', key: entry.name },
                        h('button', {
                          type: 'button', className: 'sqx-schema-name',
                          onClick: () => setExpandedSchemas((current) => ({ ...current, [entry.name]: !schemaExpanded })),
                        },
                          h(Chevron, { open: schemaExpanded }),
                          h('span', null, entry.name),
                          h('span', { className: 'sqx-count' }, String(entry.tables.length)),
                        ),
                        schemaExpanded ? entry.tables.map((table) => {
                          const key = `${entry.name}.${table.name}`;
                          const tableExpanded = expandedTables[key] === true;
                          return h('div', { key },
                            h('div', { className: 'sqx-table-row' },
                              h('button', {
                                type: 'button', className: 'sqx-table',
                                title: t('schema.tableHint'),
                                onClick: () => insertTable(entry.name, table.name),
                              },
                                h('span', { className: 'sqx-table-name', title: `${entry.name}.${table.name}` }, table.name),
                                table.estimatedRows !== null && table.estimatedRows !== undefined && table.estimatedRows > 0
                                  ? h('span', { className: 'sqx-table-meta' }, formatCount(table.estimatedRows))
                                  : null,
                                h('span', { className: 'sqx-table-meta', title: t(kindKey(table.kind)) }, table.kind === 'r' ? '' : table.kind.toUpperCase()),
                              ),
                              h('button', {
                                type: 'button', className: 'sqx-table-expand',
                                'aria-expanded': tableExpanded,
                                'aria-label': tableExpanded ? t('schema.collapse') : t('schema.expand'),
                                title: tableExpanded ? t('schema.collapse') : t('schema.expand'),
                                onClick: () => setExpandedTables((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: !tableExpanded })),
                              }, h(Chevron, { open: tableExpanded })),
                            ),
                            tableExpanded ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-columns' },
                              table.columns.map((column) => h('div', { className: 'sqx-column', key: column.name },
                                h('span', { className: 'sqx-column-name' }, column.name),
                                h('span', { className: 'sqx-column-type', title: column.type }, (column.nullable ? '' : '• ') + column.type),
                              )),
                            ) : null,
                          );
                        }) : null,
                      );
                    }),
          ) : null,
        );
      }

      function renderEditor() {
        return h('div', { className: 'sqx-editor' },
          h('textarea', {
            className: 'sqx-textarea',
            value: draft,
            spellCheck: false,
            placeholder: t('editor.placeholder'),
            'aria-label': t('title'),
            onChange: (event) => setDraft(event.target.value),
            onKeyDown,
          }),
          h('div', { className: 'sqx-toolbar' },
            h('button', { type: 'button', className: 'sqx-btn sqx-btn-primary', disabled: running, onClick: () => { void run(); } },
              h(PlayGlyph),
              running ? t('editor.running') : t('editor.run'),
            ),
            h('select', {
              className: 'sqx-select',
              value: String(limit),
              title: t('editor.limit'),
              'aria-label': t('editor.limit'),
              onChange: (event) => setPrefs((current) => ({ ...current, limit: Number(event.target.value) })),
            },
              h('option', { value: '0' }, t('editor.limitNone')),
              [100, 500, 1000, 5000].map((value) => h('option', { key: value, value: String(value) }, `LIMIT ${value}`)),
            ),
            h('button', {
              type: 'button', className: 'sqx-btn sqx-btn-quiet',
              onClick: () => setHistoryOpen((open) => !open),
            }, t('editor.history')),
            h('button', {
              type: 'button', className: 'sqx-btn sqx-btn-quiet',
              onClick: () => { setDraft(''); setResult(null); setError(null); },
            }, t('editor.clear')),
            h('span', { className: 'sqx-hint' }, t('editor.hint')),
          ),
          historyOpen ? renderHistory() : null,
        );
      }

      function renderHistory() {
        return h('div', { className: 'sqx-panel' },
          h('div', { className: 'sqx-panel-title' }, t('history.title')),
          history.length === 0
            ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-note' }, t('history.empty'))
            : history.map((entry, index) => h('button', {
                key: index,
                type: 'button',
                className: 'sqx-history-item',
                title: entry.sql,
                onClick: () => { setDraft(entry.sql); setHistoryOpen(false); },
              },
                entry.sql.replace(/\s+/g, ' '),
                h('span', { className: 'sqx-history-meta' },
                  entry.ok ? `${entry.rows} ${t('results.rows')} · ${formatDuration(entry.ms)}` : t('history.failed')),
              )),
          h('div', { className: 'sqx-row' },
            h('button', {
              type: 'button', className: 'sqx-btn sqx-btn-quiet',
              disabled: history.length === 0,
              onClick: () => setHistory([]),
            }, t('history.clear')),
          ),
        );
      }

      function renderOutput() {
        if (error !== null) {
          return h('div', { className: 'sqx-results' },
            h('div', { className: 'sqx-error' },
              h('div', { className: 'sqx-error-title' }, t('results.errorTitle')),
              h('div', { className: 'sqx-error-message' }, error.message),
              error.detail && error.detail.sqlState
                ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-error-extra' }, `SQLSTATE ${error.detail.sqlState}`)
                : null,
              error.detail && error.detail.detail
                ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-error-extra' }, error.detail.detail)
                : null,
              error.detail && error.detail.hint
                ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-error-extra' }, `HINT: ${error.detail.hint}`)
                : null,
            ),
          );
        }
        if (result === null) {
          return h('div', { className: 'sqx-results' }, h('div', { className: 'sqx-empty' }, t('results.empty')));
        }
        const isRows = result.kind === 'rows';
        return h('div', { className: 'sqx-results' },
          h('div', { className: 'sqx-results-bar' },
            isRows
              ? `${result.rowCount} ${t('results.rows')} · ${formatDuration(result.durationMs)}`
              : `${t('results.command')} ${result.command || ''} · ${formatDuration(result.durationMs)}`,
            result.limited ? ` · ${t('results.limited', { count: result.limit })}` : null,
            h('span', { className: 'sqx-spacer' }),
            isRows && result.rowCount > 0
              ? h('button', {
                  type: 'button', className: 'sqx-btn sqx-btn-quiet',
                  onClick: () => downloadText(`${target.database}-${Date.now()}.csv`, toCsvText(result.columns, result.rows)),
                }, t('results.export'))
              : null,
          ),
          isRows
            ? h(ResultGrid, { t, columns: result.columns, rows: result.rows })
            : h('div', { className: 'sqx-empty' }, result.command || 'OK'),
        );
      }

      function renderConnectionPanel() {
        const rows = [];
        if (target !== null) {
          rows.push([t('connection.database'), target.database]);
          rows.push([t('connection.host'), `${target.host}:${target.port}`]);
          if (target.user !== null) rows.push([t('connection.user'), target.user]);
          if (target.slot !== null && target.slot !== undefined) rows.push([t('connection.slot'), String(target.slot)]);
          if (target.envFile) rows.push([t('connection.detected'), target.envFile]);
          rows.push([t('connection.cwd'), target.cwd]);
          if (connection !== null && connection.ok) {
            rows.push([t('connection.serverVersion'), `${connection.serverVersion} · ${connection.user}`]);
          }
        }
        return h('div', { className: 'sqx-panel' },
          h('div', { className: 'sqx-panel-title' }, t('connection.title')),
          rows.length > 0
            ? h('dl', { className: 'sqx-kv' }, rows.map(([label, value], index) => h(React.Fragment, { key: index },
                h('dt', null, label),
                h('dd', null, value),
              )))
            : null,
          connection !== null && !connection.ok
            ? h('div', { className: 'sqx-note sqx-note-bad' }, connection.message)
            : null,
          h('div', { className: 'sqx-panel-title', style: { marginTop: '10px' } }, t('connection.manual')),
          h('input', {
            className: 'sqx-input',
            type: 'password',
            value: manualUrl,
            placeholder: t('connection.manualHint'),
            'aria-label': t('connection.manual'),
            onChange: (event) => setManualUrl(event.target.value),
            onKeyDown: (event) => { if (event.key === 'Enter') void connectManual(); },
          }),
          h('div', { className: 'sqx-row' },
            h('button', { type: 'button', className: 'sqx-btn', disabled: manualBusy, onClick: () => { void connectManual(); } }, t('connection.apply')),
            target !== null && target.override
              ? h('button', { type: 'button', className: 'sqx-btn sqx-btn-quiet', disabled: manualBusy, onClick: () => { void resetManual(); } }, t('connection.reset'))
              : null,
            h('span', { className: 'sqx-spacer' }),
            h('button', { type: 'button', className: 'sqx-btn sqx-btn-quiet', onClick: () => setConnectionOpen(false) }, t('connection.close')),
          ),
          manualStatus !== null
            ? h('div', { className: manualStatus.ok ? 'sqx-note sqx-note-ok' : 'sqx-note sqx-note-bad' }, manualStatus.message)
            : null,
        );
      }
    }

    // ── Plugin ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    function apply(ctx) {
      ctx.effect(() => {
        const sheet = document.createElement('style');
        sheet.dataset.dshSqlExplorer = '';
        sheet.textContent = CSS;
        document.head.append(sheet);
        return () => sheet.remove();
      }, 'sql-explorer: stylesheet');
      ctx.effect(() => ctx.locale.register(NS, { en, zh }), 'sql-explorer: copy');
      const t = ctx.locale.bind(NS);

      ctx.effect(() => ctx.slots.inject('conversation.view', () => ctx.slots.register({
        name: 'conversation.view',
        id: KIND,
        order: 20,
        locale: NS,
        label: () => t('view.label'),
        inject: (sessionId) => ({ sessionId }),
      }, Explorer)), 'sql-explorer: conversation view tab');
    }

    return {
      inject: ['slots', 'locale'],
      apply,
    };
  },
});
```
